text_block_list.text:
At last, the day of the Classic Triple Crown's "Satsuki Sho" has arrived.
A massive crowd had gathered at the racecourse, and—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Mihono Bourbon's gonna pull it off!
I came here today just to cheer for her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Personally, I'm leaning toward Matikanetannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "I just get the feeling she's gonna pull off something big. I can't explain it well, though."

Her heart was racing with excitement
for the fierce battle that was about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There were so many customers~!
It was just like a festival!
choice_data_list: Don't be nervous. Do your best!
Don't be nervous, just do your best, okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

There's no sign of her being overly hyped up.
Just as I was breathing a sigh of relief seeing her calm state—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Gasp!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, wait!
Let's head over that way, Trainer!
For some reason, I was made to hide in the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The underground tunnel is where horse girls
fire themselves up before heading out to race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I caught wind of your tremendous enthusiasm,
and thought I shouldn't disturb you... you see.

Looking where Machikane Tannhauser was pointing—
Mihono Bourbon stood waiting quietly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
*Inhale*... *phew*...
Body and mind both in optimal condition.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Achieving the Triple Crown is the long-cherished desire of my father and me—
The only condition to fulfill the order is victory.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Initiating mission...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: As expected of the Umamusume hailed as the protagonist of this race...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
“—Uh-oh, someone else is coming!
Is that... Rice?”

Rice Shower—
A petite, reserved Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm keeping up with Bourbon-san.
Keeping up, keeping up...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If Rice follows her... she can change too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become... an Umamusume who makes everyone smile,
just like Miss Bourbon...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Do your best, Rice.
Do your best... Yay!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hohohoh...! I see, so Rice feels that way about Bourbon...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well, well! Looks like we're in for an exciting race!

"Her phrasing sounded as if she were watching from the wings,
prompting an instinctive comeback from me."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No! That's... of course!
I'm not going to lose either!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Since everyone's expecting so much from me, I'm definitely going for the Triple Crown!
choice_data_list: Glad to hear you're up for it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well of course it is, jeez!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, I should probably be heading out too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: We're taking the Satsuki Sho! Yaaah!
Amid lingering questions, the curtain rose on the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, it was the other way around!
